The Flexeril brand has been discontinued and is no longer on the marke t, but this was a commercial decision, not a safety withdrawal: generic cyclobenzaprine tablets containing the same active ingredient remain widely available and inexpensive. 4
Current brand names include Amrix (15 mg and 30 mg extended-release capsules taken once daily), Fexmid (7.5 mg tablets), and Tonmya (2.8 mg sublingual tablets for fibromyalgia, approved August 2025). 2,3

B. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
